slides.say: Some values change without React knowing, like navigator dot on line. Read them with use sync external store.
Subscribe takes a callback, calls it whenever the store changes, and returns a function that unsubscribes.
Get snapshot returns the current value. When the callback fires, React calls get snapshot again and re-renders if the value changed.

slides.text: Server rendering? Pass a 3rd argument: getServerSnapshot.
slides.say: Rendering on the server? Pass a third function, get server snapshot. Without it, server rendering throws.
